comment.body_excerpt: Additional data point: this still reproduces on **v2026.9.9**, where it turns into an endless startup loop instead of a single failed poll ... mpts instead of looping. The fixes that landed between 9.7 and 9.9 are in the commit ancestry, but they don't cover this bind-mount case.

reasons: Technical reproduction report with environment details, migration results, a workaround, and proposed safeguards.
